market_summary: The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on Oct 28 in a 10-2 vote, with Cook and Hammack wanting a hike; Warsh would not commit on December. The curve steepened: 2-yr 4.67% (-3bp), 10-yr 5.05% (+6bp), with US crude near $101.5 on Iran concerns. The S&P 500 rose 0.28% and the Nasdaq 100 0.55%, led by memory after SK hynix's record quarter (Micron +5.9%) and Vertiv +16.6% on orders more than doubling. AI capex keeps climbing: Alphabet spent $51.4B in Q3 and fell about 10% after hours on an earnings miss, while Microsoft (capex $45.2B, Azure +48%) rose about 5%. Enphase fell 16.0% on a weak Q4 guide; China markets were not checked. Next: Amazon, Axos, Rocket ~7am AEDT Fri.

AMZN.reason: Reports Q3 on Oct 29. After Alphabet's cash-flow-driven drop, AWS growth and capex funding will set the reaction. No change before the print.

AXOS.reason: No new company news this window. The Fed held at 3.75-4% and a December hike is expected, which keeps funding costs elevated but stable for the bank.

BABA.reason: No material new news found this window. Thesis unchanged.

ENPH.reason: Q3 revenue was flat sequentially and down 29% y/y. Sell-through grew 1% against a 10% plan, and Q4 guide implies a further 13-23% fall. Data-center power is a 2028 story.

FIGR.reason: No new company news found this window. Thesis unchanged.

GOOGL.reason: Cloud revenue grew 103% with a 36% margin, but an $8.7B equity loss cut EPS and free cash flow went negative. Shares fell about 10% after hours.

LDI.reason: The Fed held and 30-year mortgage rates sit near 7.3-7.4%, a two-year high, while applications fell for seven straight weeks. A soft origination backdrop.

META.reason: No new results this window. Alphabet's negative free cash flow keeps attention on Meta's capex outrunning operating cash flow last quarter.

MRVL.reason: No company-specific news this window. Chips are mixed, with memory leading on SK Hynix's record profit.

MU.reason: Rose about 6% on Oct 28 after SK Hynix posted a record quarterly profit, which confirms tight memory pricing.

NFLX.reason: No material new news found this window.

NVDA.reason: Down about 1% on Oct 28. Alphabet's Cloud up 103% and unchanged hyperscaler capex plans support demand, though investors are now questioning how the spend is funded.

RKT.reason: Mortgage rates are near a two-year high and MBA applications have fallen seven weeks in a row. The Fed held and signalled no relief, with a December hike expected.

TSM.reason: Up about 0.4% on Oct 28. Hyperscaler capex plans remain intact, and Alphabet guided to a significant increase in 2027.

STRIPE.reason: No new valuation reported this window. The OpenRouter deal (reported at about $7.5B) is still pending.

OPENAI.reason: OpenAI cut its funding-round target to $1.25T pre-money from $1.4T after investor pushback, with commitments due Oct 30. Not yet closed, so the last mark is still $852B (TechCrunch).

headlines: Alphabet Cloud grew 103%, but an investment loss and negative free cash flow sent it down about 10% after hours.
Fed held at 3.75-4% on a 10-2 vote, two wanting a hike; 10-yr back at 5.05%.
Memory rallied on SK hynix's record quarter: Micron up 5.9%.
Enphase fell 16% on a weak Q4 guide; take moved to watch.
GE Vernova orders up 96% to about $29B; buyback doubled to $20B.
Next, AEDT: Amazon, Axos, Rocket results ~7am Fri.
